This '''obstetrician''' assisted in the delivery of [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. He was the only organic medical practitioner present at the event, and was assisted by two [[MD-series medical droid/Legends|MD-series droids]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Last Command]]'' this medic has dialogue but is not physically described, to the point of even omitting his gender. Conversely, in the [[The Last Command 1|comic adaptation]] he is depicted but has no dialogue, only giving a "thumbs-up" gesture. In both versions, the composition of the delivery room staff is the same.
